newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates Royal Bank of Canada Australia branch.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Royal Bank of Canada Australia branch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday that following the start of operations in Australia as a branch in March, the Royal Bank of Canada holds counterparty ratings of AA-minus long-term and A1-plus short term.
"The bank's competitive strength lies in its domestic retail operations, the largest in Canada in terms of both service and assets," S&P said.
The ratings outlook was stable, reflecting the bank's strong position in the Canadian banking market and its solid core profitability, S&P said.

"Following the latest recession, the bank's overall earnings performance improved considerably, primarily as a result of sharply decreased provisioning expenses. S&P expects this trend to continue, particularly if the bank's recent capital investments pay off," S&P said.
